svg.title: K12: a short DNS name only searches the Pod's own namespace
svg.desc: The Cats vs Dogs app runs in namespace k-12-dns-app with REDIS_HOST=redis. Redis runs in namespace k-12-dns-data. The short name redis is searched only in the app's own namespace, so it is not found. The full name redis.k-12-dns-data.svc.cluster.local works.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Same cluster, same name, "never heard of it"
